text:
Stop wasting your years on a p0rn actor aesthetic.

Your photos are filtered. Your feed looks like you're selling something.

Girls don't want a catalog. They want proof you're real.

Here's what works: humor, a hobby worth seeing, you're in shape, you're not broke, real opinions.

These five things signal 'I've got something going on.'

Delete two fake photos today. Replace them with you actually living.

A real life beats perfect aesthetics every time.
caption: Mindset drives dating psychology. Build real discipline. Success habits beat filters. Send this to a man who needs it today. #MindsetShift #SelfImprovement #DatingPsychology #Discipline #MentalToughness
